record.paper_title: Higher Rank Brill-Noether Theory and Coherent Systems: Open Questions
record.original_question: Fix a smooth curve C of genus g >= 2 with specified classical Clifford index Cliff_1(C). What values can the coherent-system Clifford indices Cliff_{alpha,n}(C) attain?

evidence.quote: Question 8.1. What values can Cliffα,n(C) take on a curve with specified Cliff1(C)?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $C$ be a smooth irreducible complex projective curve of genus $g \geq 2$. Recall the classical Clifford index of $C$:
$$\mathrm{Cliff}_1(C) = \min\{ \deg L - 2(h^0(L) - 1) : L \text{ a line bundle on } C \text{ with } h^0(L) \geq 2 \text{ and } h^1(L) \geq 2 \}.$$

A coherent system of type $(n,d,k)$ on $C$ is a pair $(E,V)$ where $E$ is a vector bundle on $C$ of rank $n$ and degree $d$, and $V \subseteq H^0(E)$ is a linear subspace of dimension $k$. For a real number $\alpha > 0$, the $\alpha$-slope of a coherent system $(E,V)$ of type $(n,d,k)$ is
$$\mu_\alpha(E,V) = \frac{d}{n} + \alpha \frac{k}{n},$$
and $(E,V)$ is called $\alpha$-(semi)stable if for every proper coherent subsystem $(E',V') \subset (E,V)$, $\mu_\alpha(E',V') < \mu_\alpha(E,V)$ (resp. $\leq$).

For integers $n \geq 1$ and $\alpha > 0$, define the coherent-system Clifford index
$$\mathrm{Cliff}_{\alpha,n}(C) = \min\left\{ \frac{d}{n} - 2\!\left(\frac{k}{n} - 1\right) : (E,V) \text{ is } \alpha\text{-semistable of type }(n,d,k),\ k \geq n+1,\ \mu(E) \leq g-1 \right\}.$$

Problem: Given a fixed value of the classical Clifford index $\mathrm{Cliff}_1(C)$, determine all possible values that the coherent-system Clifford indices $\mathrm{Cliff}_{\alpha,n}(C)$ can attain as $n$ and $\alpha$ vary, for curves $C$ with that prescribed $\mathrm{Cliff}_1(C)$.

artifact.status_search_result: Recent work (e.g., 2024–2025 papers on linear stability and rank-two Clifford indices, and on Clifford's theorem for coherent systems on surfaces) addresses related bounds and partial results about coherent-system Clifford indices, but the general problem of determining the precise set of values attainable by $\mathrm{Cliff}_{\alpha,n}(C)$ given $\mathrm{Cliff}_1(C)$ remains open. No source verifies a complete answer.

status_evidence.title: Linear stability and rank two Clifford indices of algebraic curves
status_evidence.snippet: Proves that any vector bundle computing the rank-two Clifford index is linearly semistable; bounds on coherent system dimension.
status_evidence.claim: Recent partial results on rank-two Clifford indices of curves but not full classification.

status_evidence.title: Clifford's Theorem for Coherent Systems on surfaces
status_evidence.snippet: Generalization of Clifford's Theorem to coherent systems, in the surface setting.
status_evidence.claim: Active research on Clifford-type bounds for coherent systems; not a resolution of the curve question.

status_evidence.title: On α-stability and linear stability of generated coherent systems
status_evidence.snippet: Studies α-stability for coherent systems on curves.
status_evidence.claim: Continued investigation of α-stability framework relevant to Cliff_{α,n}.
